name: Systeme.io
desc: Systeme.io is a CRM platform that allows you to manage your contacts, sales, and marketing campaigns.

actions.name: createContact
actions.description: Create a new contact with email and contact fields from your Systeme.io account, with optional tags

actions.name: addTagToContact
actions.description: Assign a tag to an existing contact - select an existing tag or create a new one

actions.name: removeTagFromContact
actions.description: Remove a tag that is currently assigned to an existing contact

actions.name: findContactByEmail
actions.description: Locate an existing contact by email address

actions.name: updateContact
actions.description: Update fields (name, phone, custom fields) of an existing contact using fields from your Systeme.io account

actions.name: find_contacts
actions.description: Search contacts by email, tags, sign-up date or status

actions.name: get_contact
actions.description: Get a contact with its fields and tags

actions.name: delete_contact
actions.description: Permanently delete a contact. This cannot be undone.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.description: Create a tag, or return the existing tag with the same name

actions.name: delete_tag
actions.description: Permanently delete a tag. It is removed from every contact that has it.

actions.name: enroll_contact_in_course
actions.description: Give a contact access to a course (full, partial, or drip-fed)

actions.name: remove_course_enrollment
actions.description: Remove a contact's enrollment in a course

actions.name: add_contact_to_community
actions.description: Give a contact membership of a community

actions.name: remove_contact_from_community
actions.description: Remove a contact's membership of a community

actions.name: cancel_subscription
actions.description: Cancel one of a contact's subscriptions, now or at the end of the billing period

triggers.name: newContact
triggers.description: Fires when a new contact is created

triggers.name: newSale
triggers.description: Fires when a new purchase is made within a funnel

triggers.name: newTagAddedToContact
triggers.description: Fires when a tag is assigned to a contact (optionally only a chosen tag)

triggers.name: contact_tag_removed
triggers.description: Fires when a tag is removed from a contact (optionally only a chosen tag)

triggers.name: new_opt_in
triggers.description: Fires when a contact submits an opt-in form, including contacts that already exist

triggers.name: sale_canceled
triggers.description: Fires when a sale is canceled (a subscription is canceled or a one-off payment is refunded)

guides.title: Systeme.io automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Systeme.io automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.
